OHB Sweden is a leading Swedish supplier of space systems. We develop, build, test and commission satellites and subsystems for a wide range of missions - including communications, Earth observation, and space research and exploration- serving both institutional and commercial customers within and outside Europe.
As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and justifying the mission's Ground Segment Architecture, leading specification and requirements definition activities while actively contributing to procurement and the management of contractor developments. You will play a pivotal role within the Flight Operations Team by planning, executing, and optimizing satellite operations, maintaining spacecraft health, leading real-time anomaly responses, and guiding a small team of engineers. Consequently, your technical scope will include defining onboard failure detection autonomy, drafting flight procedures and user manuals, and planning and leading ground-based System Validation Tests (SVT). Collaborating closely with internal teams and external partners to deliver robust solutions, this dynamic position demands strong leadership, exceptional communication skills, and the proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
It is desirable that you have a solid technical background in one or more of the following spacecraft engineering areas:

Data handling/Software

Ground Segment

Attitude and orbit control / Orbital mechanics

TT&C

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field

At least 5 years of experience in satellite system or subsystem engineering

Fluent in the English language, both spoken and written

Excellent interpersonal skills and communications capabilities

Strong understanding of TT&C, flight dynamics, and ground segment architecture

Experience with anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and recovery procedures

Legal authorization to work in Sweden

Added advantageous qualifications:

Experience with ESA programs and projects or other large international collaborations

Familiarity with scripting or automation tools (e.g., Python, Bash).

Knowledge of CCSDS & ECSS communication protocols

Experience of work in Mission Control during critical phases

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities

We’re looking for a proactive team player who learns quickly, provides technical guidance to colleagues, and can also work independently. Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and a pragmatic approach are essential - focusing on achieving the right balance of quality and timely delivery.
If you’re ready to be part of our journey and contribute to complex and exciting projects, we’d love to hear from you!

Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
At the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering, the university has brought together research and education in electrical engineering, space technology, computer and systems science. We are now looking for a PhD student who can contribute to our growing activities in modelling and measurement of power grids at the EISLAB division. We carry out research in the areas of electronic systems, machine learning and cyber-physical systems. The electronic systems group works with, among other things, electronic design, electrical measurement technology, electromagnetic compatibility, and modelling and measurement of power grids and energy systems. We have access to a number of laboratories and to a test bed in an inland municipality in northern Sweden, with a physics-based model of the local distribution grid and measurement nodes in the grid. 
 Subject description 
Electronics systems include electronics design, measurement technology and electromagnetic compatibility for control, monitoring and instrumentation of technical processes and systems, with close connection to applications and applied research. 
 
Project description 
The electrification of vehicles, heating and services means that local power grids and buildings need to interact in new ways. Power is often lacking in the grid during the hours when demand is highest, although the grid is lightly loaded for much of the year. Using the existing capacity safely requires better knowledge of the state of the grid, but in smaller distribution grids measurements are often sparse and delayed.
Digital twins, where physics-based models are combined with measurement data and forecasts, are a promising way to address this. Important research questions are how such models can be kept up to date with few measurement points, how uncertainty in model and data can be quantified and propagated to decisions, and how the model results can be turned into signals that buildings, EV charging and other flexible loads can follow, while maintaining comfort, function and electrical safety.
A digital twin is never better than the measurements it is built on. This is where the group's competence in electronics and measurement technology contributes. We develop our own measurement nodes that are placed in the grid, with sensors, embedded systems and local data processing, and we study how measurements from new nodes and from existing smart meters can be combined.
As a PhD student you will work in a research project in this area, in collaboration with a municipality and a local grid operator, and, with the support of our team of researchers, develop into an independent researcher. The specific focus, for example more towards modelling and state estimation or more towards measurement nodes and measurement systems, can to some extent be guided by your background and interest. 
 
Duties 
As a PhD student you are expected to perform both experimental and theoretical work within your research studies. This includes modelling of distribution grids, analysis of real measurement data, state estimation with sparse measurements and evaluation of measurement nodes in the grid, and the work includes recurring travel to the test bed. You will communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies. In addition, you can have the opportunity to try the teacher role. As a researcher, you work as a neutral party in many contexts, which provides a great opportunity to be involved in challenging development projects. 
 
Qualifications 
We are looking for committed people who have
- a solid educational background, civilingenjör or master's degree or equivalent, in electrical engineering, electric power engineering, energy engineering, control engineering or related fields,
- knowledge of programming, preferably Python, or MATLAB or C/C++,
- a foundation in power systems or circuit theory and measurement technology, preferably with experience of power flow analysis, measurement systems or embedded systems,
- effective communication skills to convey complex ideas with clarity and impact. 
 
Knowledge of Swedish is an advantage, since the work is carried out in close dialogue with a municipality and a grid operator. 
For further information about a specific subject see the general syllabus for the Board of the faculty of science and technology.

http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en
 
Further information 
Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå, with recurring travel to the test bed. Starting: by agreement.
The employment is subject to the project being granted funding. 
 
We strive for a gender balance and particularly welcome applications from women.

Join Telavox as a Security Engineer 🔐
Are you a hands-on security engineer who enjoys being close to the code, the systems, and the teams building them? At Telavox, security is not a gate at the end of development. It is an embedded capability that enables us to move fast, safely, and at scale.
Telavox is a fast-growing digital telco that combines the reliability of telecom with the agility of SaaS across Europe and across the globe. As our platform grows, security becomes a force multiplier, not just protecting what we build, but actively enabling engineers to ship better and safer software every day.
We are growing our Security Engineering team and looking for a Security Engineer to join our engineering organisation. You will work side by side with our Security Engineering Lead, sharing the same mission and many of the same activities, and bringing your own depth and perspective to the team. Together you will make security a built-in property of every system we ship, by making the secure way the easy way for every engineering team.
About the job
As a Security Engineer, you are part of the engineering execution layer that makes security real across the Platform organisation. You work across product and platform teams, building paved roads, secure defaults, and standards that teams adopt as their own, instead of doing every team's security for them.
You are a close partner to the Security Engineering Lead, who sets direction and priorities for the function. You complement each other: you share the work, challenge each other's thinking, and divide focus areas based on where your strengths are deepest. You also help bridge the gap between the CISO's strategic direction and day-to-day engineering reality, turning security goals into concrete engineering outcomes.
Your day-to-day work includes:

Build and evolve paved roads that make secure choices the default, such as vulnerability management workflows, secrets handling, and secure-by-default patterns in CI/CD

Work cross-functionally with engineering teams, understanding their context and helping them adopt security improvements in a way that fits how they build

Own and evolve vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning across our code and services, and make sure findings actually get fixed

Translate risks and requirements from customers, operators, audits, and the risk register into concrete, sized work for the right teams, and follow up so it lands and stays landed

Triage and coordinate responses to emerging threats: assess severity, involve the right teams, and drive issues to resolution

Share ownership of the security roadmap with the Security Engineering Lead, and take clear ownership of the areas where your experience is strongest

The role is based either at our new HQ in Malmö or in our Stockholm office.
About you
You are a pragmatic, hands-on security engineer who enjoys working closely with engineering teams and across team boundaries. You are comfortable moving between code, tooling, and architecture discussions, and you care about making security scalable, practical, and usable. You are just as comfortable working independently as you are in a small team where you and a colleague share responsibility for a broad area.
You believe security works best when it is distributed, automated, and embedded, not bolted on in the end. You lead through explanation and good defaults rather than gates and approvals.
You think ahead about what embedded security looks like when engineering is increasingly AI-augmented: agent credentials, MCP and tool-use boundaries, and secure-by-default workflows for code that humans and models write together.
We are looking for someone with:

A hands-on background in software or platform engineering, with real comfort in the terminal, able to run scans, inspect output, and file a PR when needed

At least 3-5 years of professional experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical role

Demonstrated experience with the security tooling landscape, such as vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning, understanding trade-offs, not just installation

Experience building shared tooling, standards, or paved roads that other engineering teams adopt

A teaching and enabling mindset: sharing knowledge, running hands-on deep-dives, and leaving capability behind rather than creating dependency

Strong ability to collaborate with engineers across teams, influence without formal authority, and translate security risks into practical engineering work

A collaborative way of working with a lead and peers, including sharing context, dividing focus areas, and giving and receiving honest feedback

Fluent English, written and spoken. Swedish is a plus

Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
How to apply!
At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English. 
For any questions, feel free to reach out to Hiring Manager Filip Ahlberg at filip.ahlberg@telavox.com
Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

Platform Team Lead
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time
The Role:
The Platform team creates the foundations that help Netlight’s builders start faster, ship safely, and work with confidence. Its scope spans cloud landing zones, developer environments, CI/CD, observability, service-catalogue capabilities, and AI tooling. We are looking for a Team Lead who can help a senior team turn these components into a reliable, easy-to-use platform.
You will protect the health of today’s services while helping the team invest in what comes next: production-grade cloud environments, clear self-service paths, stronger operational practices, and practical AI-assisted development. You will report to the Head of Tech and work closely with Operations and technical teams across Netlight.
At Netlight, the Team Lead role combines Engineering Manager responsibilities – people, technology, and business impact – with Product Manager responsibilities: problem discovery, stakeholder management, and prioritisation. You set direction, remove blockers, and make trade-offs visible. Goals, budget envelopes, and hiring decisions are shaped with the Head of Tech.

With your help, we want to:
- Make hard-won operational knowledge shared and documented, so reliability does not depend on one person’s memory.
- Develop Builder Experience Foundations into production-grade environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- Build AI-platform tooling and workflows that help builders adopt AI-assisted development with confidence.
- Create clear standards, guardrails, and self-service onboarding so teams can build on solid foundations from day one.

Who you are
You can lead through ambiguity, turn competing needs into clear priorities, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work.
You will thrive in this role if you bring:
- Strong prioritisation skills and a product mindset. You can balance operational requests, strategic investment, and team capacity.
- Experience building or running a platform as a product. You understand self-service, golden paths, service catalogues, clear ownership, and useful defaults – not only keeping infrastructure available.
- A self-directed, improvement-oriented mindset. You spot what can work better and turn that observation into focused action.
- A track record of advocating clearly for your team with leadership and stakeholders. You can challenge a commitment while keeping the conversation constructive.
- Strong communication skills. You explain technical trade-offs in business terms and turn business needs into choices engineers can act on.

Qualifications
We are looking for someone with:
- At least three years of experience leading software-engineering teams.
- Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, or a combination of these platforms. You do not need to be hands-on every day, but you should make informed calls and earn credibility with the team.
- A record of bringing structure to ambiguous, high-pressure situations and turning them into well-run operations.
- The ability to work from a Netlight office at least three days per week.
- Fluency in English.
- Swedish or German skills are a plus.

Nice to have:
- Experience with GitLab CI/CD or similar developer-infrastructure platforms.
- Experience working in a Developer Experience or Platform Building group, team, or area.
- Direct experience with AI coding assistants or custom LLM-based developer tooling.
- Familiarity with cloud cost governance or FinOps.

What you will do:
You will lead a small, senior platform team responsible for cloud landing zones, AI tooling, and builder-experience components including monitoring, CI/CD, and service catalogue capabilities. The team wants to invest more energy in cloud and builder infrastructure. Your leadership will help it do that while keeping shared services dependable.
You will work closely with the Head of Tech, Operations, and technical teams. Your key responsibilities will be to:
- Team leadership and development: Set direction, coach, and grow engineers. Build an environment where ideas, risks, and concerns surface early and feedback leads to action.
- Operational oversight: Maintain a clear view of cloud and builder-experience platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including GitLab and CI/CD. Build documentation and knowledge-sharing practices that make the platform resilient by design.
- Planning and execution: Shape the cloud-infrastructure and AI-platform roadmap. Balance stability work with the ambition to build strong builder infrastructure and guide the adoption of AI-assisted development tooling where it creates value.
- Communication and collaboration: Represent the team’s needs and constraints upward. Involve the team before making commitments that affect its scope, capacity, or working conditions.
- Culture and engagement: Build trust through consistency. Close the loop on feedback, follow through on commitments, and make room for different perspectives.

What we offer:
- The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry - and contribute to the continued growth of our thriving Stockholm office.
- Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
- Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
- A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
- Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
- Mental health & parental support offerings
- 30 days of paid vacation.

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:
- Deutschlandticket
- Wellpass

Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:
- 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
- Private pension savings

About us
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.

Come work with us
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.

Apply today
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
Send us your current CV. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

You will have overall responsibility for financial planning and analysis, accounting, compliance, risk management, and investor relations. Working closely with the CEO, the board, and department heads, you will provide reliable financial insights, oversee key SaaS metrics, and support strategic decisions regarding pricing, resource allocation, and international growth.
We value efficiency and modern ways of working, and we expect you to continuously develop and automate our financial processes using digital tools and AI.
What are you going to do?
Strategic leadership: Act as a strategic partner to the CEO and the leadership team in shaping and executing Verified’s strategy and growth plan, and translate strategy into financial plans, priorities and capital allocation.

KPI framework and performance management: Implement and own a company-wide KPI framework and a data-driven approach to follow-up, anchored in a commercial and functional understanding of the business.

Planning and forecasting: Own the budget process, forecasting and the long-term financial plan.

Board and owners: Prepare and present financial reporting and analysis to the Board. Act as the main finance counterpart to the company’s owners, lenders and auditors, and ensure the company is prepared for future ownership events.

Financing and treasury: Manage cash, liquidity, banking relationships and financing arrangements.

Governance and control: Ensure sound financial controls, accounting, tax, audit and financial policies, in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Siemens Energy AB i Finspång söker en erfaren VVS-specialist med djup teknisk kompetens inom drift av ventilation, kyla och tryckluft.
Rollen är inriktad på att säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, energieffektivitet, driftsäkerhet och långsiktig funktion i tekniska installationer. 
Du arbetar nära driftorganisation, underhåll, verksamhet och externa leverantörer med felsökning, optimering, förebyggande underhåll och tekniska förbättringar.

Ansvara för teknisk driftuppföljning av ventilations-, kyl- och tryckluftssystem.
Analysera driftdata, larm, energianvändning och återkommande fel samt föreslå och genomföra förbättringsåtgärder.
Utföra kvalificerad felsökning och rotorsaksanalyser tillsammans med drift- och underhållspersonal.
Optimera systemfunktion, reglerstrategier, temperaturer, luftflöden, trycknivåer och drifttider.
Ta fram och utveckla driftinstruktioner, underhållsplaner, kontrollpunkter och teknisk dokumentation.
Medverka vid statusbedömningar, besiktningar, funktionsprovning, injustering och driftsättning av tekniska system.
Agera tekniskt sakkunnig i projekt genom att ta fram och granska tekniska krav, systemlösningar, handlingar och anbud samt säkerställa att drift-, underhålls- och energikrav beaktas genom hela projektet.
Ställa tekniska krav på entreprenörer och leverantörer samt följa upp att utförda åtgärder ger avsedd funktion.
Vara tekniskt stöd till verksamheten i frågor som rör inneklimat, processkyla, komfortkyla, ventilation och tryckluft.

Erfarenhet
Flerårig erfarenhet av teknisk drift, underhåll och felsökning inom ventilation, kyla och tryckluft, gärna från industriella anläggningar eller annan verksamhet med höga krav på tillgänglighet.

Relevant teknisk utbildning inom VVS, energi, driftteknik eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet.
Mycket god kunskap om ventilationssystem, luftbehandling, flödesbalansering, filter, fläktar, värmeåtervinning och styrning.
God kunskap om kylsystem, kylmaskiner, värmepumpar, köldbärarsystem, kondensorer och tillhörande reglerfunktioner.
God kunskap om tryckluftssystem, kompressorer, torkar, filtrering, distributionsnät, läckagesökning och energieffektiv drift.
Erfarenhet av styr- och övervakningssystem samt förmåga att tolka driftbilder, trendkurvor, larm och reglersekvenser.
Förmåga att utföra och bedöma mätningar av temperatur, tryck, flöde, luftkvalitet och energiprestanda.
Erfarenhet av energioptimering, förebyggande underhåll och tekniska förbättringar med ett tydligt livscykelperspektiv.
Det är meriterande med kompetens inom energi, exempelvis energianalys och energieffektivisering av tekniska installationer.
Förmåga att läsa och granska ritningar, flödesscheman, driftkort, funktionsbeskrivningar och tekniska manualer.
Kunskap om relevanta myndighetskrav och säkerhetsregler för VVS-, kyl- och tryckluftsanläggningar.

Engagerad
Drivande
Djup teknisk kompetens och erfarenhet av drift inom ventilation, kyla och tryckluft
Ansvarstagande och strukturerad
Analytisk och metodisk vid felsökning
Bra initiativförmåga

Självständig
